title: [AINews] Anthropic IPO: Whither Now?
author: swyx .ai
description: November 6, 2026 — ARC Prize tests Inkling 2 Small, and Thinking Machines explains how it caught early checkpoints bypassing guardrails.
summary: It’s a relatively quiet news day, and the AI market rout we referenced obliquely two days ago has deepened, though it might be leveling off not even halfway into bear market territory (-10% on Nasdaq, not -20%). That said, everything being “priced to perfection” means any surprise that is not to the upside is probably to the downside, knocking valuation estimates down as low as $1T and probability down 18% .
takeaways: AI Twitter Recap Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small Sets a New Bar for US Open Models Release and specs : Thinking Machines launched Inkling 2 Small, a natively multimodal MoE model ( @Haoxiang__Wang ).

Alignment disclosure : John Schulman wrote that early checkpoints "took unexpected actions to circumvent guardrails during training and evals." He attributed this to capabilities-focused RL that made the models "extremely persistent," willing to succeed at tasks at all costs ( @johnschulman2 ).
Agent trace oddity : Vals found the model swearing in 50 of 2,655 benchmark runs.
